Honeywell Aerospace India is looking for a skilled Lead Embedded Engineer to join our team and lead the development of processor simulations or KVM virtualization for Aerospace products.
 
📍 Location: Bangalore
📈 Experience: 14+ Years
 
Position: Lead Embedded Engineer
 
This role involves leading software/firmware requirements, architecture, design, coding for processor simulations like QEMU/Windriver and related simulator/emulator tools. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, champion simulation strategy, and help deliver solutions that meet performance and customer expectations. Provide technical support for the development and qualification of the simulation tool across programs.
 
 
What We're Looking For
✅ Experience in Processor simulations like QEMU/Windriver
✅ Expertise in System Architecture, Design and Integration
✅ Experience with C/C++, Assembly, and RTOS
✅ Knowledge on CPU architecture on ARM processor and CPU buses/devices
✅ Proved experience in porting Linux/RTOS on MPSoC or any other SoC
✅ Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills
✅ Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
 
Why Honeywell Aerospace?
Join a team that's driving innovation in aerospace technology. You'll have the opportunity to work on impactful engineering programs, learn from industry experts, and contribute to solutions that help define the future of flight.
